Item Description:
Polished Agate Geode Bookends (Brazil), Turquoise, White, Green, Black Exterior
A pair of polished natural agate geode slabs, made into bookends; could also be used as separate desk sculptures or paperweights. Have a crusty black/purplish exterior with what appears to be natural but may be dyed turquoise upper layer "skin" border, with a white and clear feathered crystalline inner structure. On the reverse side, the surface is a more mottled and striped sage green and other teal and green hues more matte polished stone.
